Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=lineitem.extended_price DESC, lineitem_id ASC]
    Project[customer.name AS cust_name, orders.id AS order_id, lineitem.id AS lineitem_id, lineitem.extended_price AS extended_price, lineitem.discount AS discount]
      Filter[customer.nation = 'GERMANY' AND lineitem.discount > 0.05]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=orders.id = lineitem.order_id]
          Join[kind=inner, cond=customer.id = orders.cust_id]
            Scan[customer]
            Scan[orders]
          Scan[lineitem]
